title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue That the People's Court Shall Not Accept a Retrial Application Filed by a Party Against a Ruling Rejecting Its Application to Set Aside an Arbitration Award

articles.content_en:
July 26, 2004
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Issue of Whether the People's Court
Shall Not Accept a Party's Application for Retrial if the Party is Dissatisfied with the Ruling Dismissing Its Application for Setting Aside an Arbitration Award
Fa Shi [2004] No. 9
Higher People's Court of Shaanxi Province:
Your court's Shaan Gao Fa [2004] No. 225 'Request for Instructions on Whether the People's Court Shall Accept a Retrial Application by a Party Dissatisfied with the Ruling Dismissing Its Application for Setting Aside an Arbitration Award' has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
In accordance with the spirit of Article 9 of the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China, if a party applies for retrial because it is dissatisfied with a People's Court's ruling dismissing its application for setting aside an arbitration award, the People's Court shall not accept the case.
This is hereby replied.
